top.line: VoiceDebrief is ready to relaunch: a simpler core, agent workflows moved to the CRM, and a proper App Store launch.
top.para: Its own name, accounts, domains and payments.

in-short.line: Ready for market; the core works; it grew a workbench; keep, move, add; do it properly; dream bigger.

features.line: Record without loss, on-device transcript and debrief, a library, vaults, sending, identity, credit.
features.para: 35 screens tested; a web version and MeetScribe beside it.

simpler.line: The agent workbench moves to the CRM app; the core stays; payments, account, share sheet and iCloud are added.
simpler.para: Designed for one workflow, too complex for a first product.

vision.line: Fifteen features: debriefs per occasion, actions out, ask all your notes, brief me before, record from anywhere.
vision.para: The whole vision for the relaunch team.

market.line: Name and domains, its own Apple accounts, App Store payments, privacy and review, usage, launch.
market.para: On-device processing keeps the cost of a note low.

limits.line: Many features unverified on a device; payments, account and listing not built; single-run timings.

sources.line: The VoiceDebrief iOS repository's reality file, credit page, review sheets and issues, and its sites.
